login.title: Airport admin
login.intro: Staff access for publishing the weekly flight schedule.
login.notConfigured: Admin access is not configured on this server. Set ADMIN_PASSWORD and SESSION_SECRET.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds}s.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.published: Schedule published. The public board is showing it now.
dashboard.noticeLive: That schedule is now on the public board.
dashboard.noticeCleared: No schedule is on the board. The public site says none has been published; the upload is still here and can be put back.
dashboard.noticeDeleted: Schedule deleted, along with its flights and its workbook.
dashboard.noticeMissing: That schedule no longer exists. Nothing changed.
dashboard.noneYet: No schedule has been published yet. The public board is showing its empty state.
dashboard.historyIntro: Publishing keeps the previous schedule rather than replacing it, so you can put an earlier week back on the board at any time. Taking one off the board is reversible; deleting is not.
dashboard.confirmWeek: Type the week start date {week} to confirm deletion
dashboard.confirmMismatch: That is not this schedule’s week. Nothing was deleted.

schedule.title: Upload schedule
schedule.showing: The board is currently showing {count} flights for {from} … {to}. It keeps showing them until you confirm a replacement.
schedule.noneYet: No schedule is published yet. This will be the first.
schedule.fileHint: Nothing is published yet — the next screen shows what the file contains so you can check it first.
schedule.errorTooLarge: That file is {size} MB. The limit is 5 MB.
schedule.errorNotXlsx: That is not an .xlsx workbook. Export the schedule as Excel (.xlsx) and try again.
schedule.errorExpired: That upload is no longer available. Upload the file again.
schedule.errorHasErrors: This file has errors and cannot be published. Fix them and upload again.
schedule.errorFailedValidation: This file failed validation and was not published.
schedule.previewIntro: Nothing has been published. The board is still showing the previous schedule.
schedule.errorsIntro: These block publishing. Fix the file and upload it again.
schedule.warningsIntro: These do not block publishing, but are worth a look.
schedule.blocked: This file cannot be published until the errors above are fixed.

news.title: News
news.count: {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}, {drafts} unpublished.
news.emptyHint: Posts written here appear in the press centre. Nothing is public until it is marked published, so a draft can be prepared in advance.
news.newIntro: Nothing is public until the published box is ticked, so this can be filled in and left.
news.notPublished: Not published. It will appear at {path}.
news.deleteIntro: Permanent. To take a post off the public site while keeping it, unpublish it instead — that is reversible, and one click on the news list.
news.confirmTitle: To delete this post, type its headline:
news.confirmMismatch: That is not the headline of this post. Nothing was deleted.
news.languageFixed: The language and the address are fixed once a post exists, so links to it keep working.
news.headline: Headline
news.summaryHint: Shown in the news list and to search engines. Left empty, the list shows the headline alone.
news.markdownHint: Markdown. A blank line starts a paragraph; ## makes a heading, - a list item, and [text](https://…) a link.
news.coverUpload: Upload a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF (max 2 MB)
news.coverReplace: Replace with a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF (max 2 MB)
news.imageDescriptionHint: Required when there is an image: it is what a screen reader announces, and what shows if the picture fails to load. Describe what it shows, not that it is a photograph.
news.translationHint: Linked posts point at each other on the public site, so a reader who opens the wrong language is told where the right one is.
news.publishedCheckbox: Published — visible on the public site
news.errorExcerptLong: The summary is limited to {max} characters.
news.errorBodyShort: That is too short to publish.
news.errorBodyLong: The post is limited to {max} characters.
news.errorAltRequired: Describe the image for readers who cannot see it.
news.errorAltShort: That description is too short to be useful.
news.errorAltLong: Image descriptions are limited to {max} characters.
news.errorImageTooLarge: That image is {size} MB. The limit is 2 MB.
news.errorImageType: That is not a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF image.

documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: Files published on the site’s pages — orders, protocols, tariffs. They appear under the page they are filed against, newest first.
documents.filesHint: {formats}, up to 25 MB each. Select as many as you like — each one is listed below afterwards, where its title can be corrected.
documents.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} uploaded.
documents.emptyHint: Nothing uploaded yet. Files added here appear on the page they are filed against, with their format and size shown next to the link.
documents.errorChoosePage: Choose the page these belong to.
documents.errorTooLarge: {filename} is {size} MB. The limit is 25 MB.
